subject: Internal: LumaHealth MAP pre-kickoff & RACI
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumaHealth MAP pre-kickoff — internal prep

Team,

We have the LumaHealth evaluation kickoff with Erin next Tuesday (14th). Before the customer kick we should align internally on roles, decision criteria, and the draft MAP so our kickoff is crisp and we leave with clear action items / owners. High-level asks: 

- Confirm RACI for the external stakeholders Erin has mapped (product eval, security, procurement).
- Validate the evaluation criteria I added in the attached doc and surface any missing success metrics.
- Identify any outstanding security artifacts they will ask for (I already expect SOC2 + logs).
- Agree on proposed timeline to close (they're targeting end-of-Aug).

I attached a first-pass MAP and an evaluation criteria markdown. Please review and reply with: 
1) RACI edits (in bullet form)
2) Any blockers (legal, security evidence gaps)
3) Availability for a quick internal prep tomorrow (08/07) 3-3:30pm PT or 4-4:30pm PT.

Thanks — want to keep this lean so the customer call is an execution meeting, not discovery.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: LumaHealth_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), evaluation-criteria.md (text), redwood-security-questions.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaHealth MAP pre-kickoff — internal prep

Grace — quick take after a pass through the MAP draft:

RACI suggestions (high level):
- Erin Walsh (LumaHealth): A (Approve) for final purchase, R for acceptance of POC results
- Product evaluation lead (they named "Samir Patel"): R for feature sign-off; C for SLOs
- Security (LumaHealth): A for security acceptance; we should mark Redwood Security as R (provide artifacts)
- CS (Redwood - Laura): R for onboarding plan and POC success criteria
- Infra/ops (Redwood - Marcus): R for capacity/throughput verification and test harness
- AE (Grace): A for project timeline and commercial terms

Missing success metrics to add to evaluation-criteria.md:
- 95th percentile latency budget (ms) for their typical batch sizes
- Token throughput per minute target for 10 concurrent evals
- Quality pass rate on their sample prompt set (they provided 500 prompts)

Security gaps: ask them about log retention windows and whether they need dedicated capacity (Reserved) for data isolation — that'll change the procurement path.

I can do the internal prep at 3pm PT tomorrow.

—Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 14:22:50 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaHealth MAP pre-kickoff — internal prep

Adding ops notes:

- Test harness: we'll need the 500-prompt set and expected evaluation sampling plan (batch sizes, concurrency). Can we ask Erin to share the prompts ahead of the kickoff? If they can't, schedule a follow-up to exchange the set within 48 hours post-kickoff.
- Capacity: if they plan to run long-running evals we should size a temporary dedicated pool; otherwise shared hosted is fine for discovery. Estimate for dedicated 8xA10G pool for 2 weeks ~ cost estimate (we can produce numbers once they confirm concurrency).
- KV cache and prefix caching: call out as part of performance playbook — include as a bullet in the MAP under 'Performance verification'.

Blockers: I need the list of PII-sensitive prompt examples (if any) so we can validate redaction/retention flows.

Available 4-4:30pm PT for the internal prep call.

Marcus Lin
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 15:10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaHealth MAP pre-kickoff — internal prep

Couple of operational notes from CS and legal: 

- Laura (CS) will own POC success measurement and the onboarding checklist (I'll draft the checklist and attach before the customer kickoff).
- Legal sync: procurement will ask for standard T&C redlines; if they request data residency we need to involve private deployment discussions which will lengthen timeline.
- Attachments: I've uploaded a one-page POC acceptance criteria template to the Drive link in related_links (I'll paste the link in the prep invite).

I can make the 3pm slot as well. I recommend we run the internal prep at 3-3:30pm PT to include Neha's technical perspective. If any of you prefer 4pm, we can switch but we lose some overlap with EMEA folks later.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

2) Actions for the internal call (please bring answers):
   - Neha: revise evaluation-criteria.md with the additional performance/quality metrics and include a 'pass/fail' column.

If anything urgent pops up before 3pm, ping me on Slack. Otherwise see you at 3.
